analysis: Essential tremor is a common neurological disorder characterized by involuntary shaking of hands, head, and sometimes other parts of the body. It typically worsens with movement and is not present at rest. Essential tremor is not usually improved with levodopa or alcohol intake. Propranolol is a common medication used to help manage essential tremor symptoms.
